title: Hellish Grocery Abyss
description: A surreal painting depicts a massive demonic creature with a single glowing red eye and molten lava dripping from its maw, rising from a cracked, fiery ground littered with shopping debris. In the upper left, two silhouetted human figures with a shopping cart walk toward a swirling colorful galaxy vortex against a chaotic background of turbulent fiery spirals and smoke.
prompt: Surreal apocalyptic painting of a giant black demonic monster with one glowing red eye and molten lava flowing from its mouth, emerging from cracked burning ground covered in shopping trash and receipts. Two human silhouettes pushing a grocery cart walk toward a massive swirling colorful galaxy vortex in the sky, surrounded by fiery orange and green spirals, smoke and cosmic chaos, dramatic painterly brushstrokes, dark fantasy style
